Chapter 350: Chapter 10 Command the Ten Great Mountain Ranges’ Demon Beast Kings with my Law Decree (Happy New Year)_2

The Tianqing Alliance Leader saw off the twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs.

Next, in order to fully mobilize all the forces of the Tianqing World, the Vice Alliance Hierarchs, protectors, elders, and other senior members of the alliance would travel within the Tianqing World.

He, however, needed to continue presiding over the battlefield to prevent the final counterattack of the Ancestral Demon Tree.

“Everything is almost over.”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader mused to himself with a deep and thoughtful gaze.

…

...

Outside the Black Mist Mountain Range.

Two streaks of light descended.

“This is the Black Mist Mountain Range.”

“I remember, the Black Mist Mountain Range has eight Demon Beast Kings; the strongest is the Giant Elephant King, possessing the bloodline of an ancient divine elephant…”

The two streaks of light transformed into two figures; on the left was a lean old man named ‘Qu Zhuang,’ an elder of the Tianqing Alliance.

The Tianqing Alliance had one hundred fifty-six elders, each wielding Sixth Rank strength, belonging to the alliance’s upper echelon of power.

The one on the right was a young man named ‘Liao An,’ also an elder of the Tianqing Alliance.

Unlike the elder ‘Qu Zhuang,’ ‘Liao An’ was quite young, just over three hundred years old, had not even been born when the Tianqing World first encountered the invasion of the Ancestral Demon Tree.

Thus, ‘Liao An’ had never been to the Black Mist Mountain Range; he had spent most of his time on the Evil God Battlefield, fighting against countless violent and cruel Evil God Puppets.

“Let’s go.”

“We should head inside.”

The lean old man ‘Qu Zhuang’ then briefed ‘Liao An’ on some information about the Black Mist Mountain Range and moved to enter it.

The purpose of their visit was clear.

It was to convey the decree of the Tianqing Alliance Leader, commanding the eight Demon Beast Kings of the Black Mist Mountain Range to go to the Evil God Battlefield, preparing for the upcoming counterattack.

“The Alliance Leader aligned the heavens and the earth, and against the Foreign Evil Gods, he even holds a dominating advantage, and now he’s preparing to counterattack…”

All the way, the lean elder ‘Qu Zhuang’ couldn’t help but express his emotion; he was indeed shocked when he first heard the Alliance Leader’s command to gather all forces of the Tianqing World for a counterattack.

“Indeed.”

Liao An nodded.

“I hope that after repelling the Evil God, I can have a home…”

Liao An couldn’t help but say.

“That’s easy.”

“With your strength and status, once the Evil God is repelled, you’ll be a hero of heaven and earth, and countless beautiful women will throw themselves at you…”

The lean elder ‘Qu Zhuang’ laughed heartily.

As they walked, the two chatted.

Suddenly.

Liao An stopped.

He looked carefully around.

“What’s wrong?”

The lean elder ‘Qu Zhuang’ also stopped, looking at Liao An with a puzzled expression.

“It’s nothing.”

“I just feel, isn’t it too quiet?”

Liao An furrowed his brows slightly, “Although I’ve never been to the Black Mist Mountain Range, I’ve heard that this place is teeming with ferocious demonic beasts; it shouldn’t be this quiet…”

To become an elder of the Tianqing Alliance at just over three hundred years old.

Besides because of the increased opportunities to demonstrate valor due to the Ancestral Demon Tree’s invasion, Liao An also possessed a kind of intuition and instinct that was unlike ordinary people’s.

He often sensed danger before it arrived.

“It is indeed a bit quiet.”

The lean elder ‘Qu Zhuang’ nodded slightly.

“But it should be nothing to worry about, right? Maybe the few Demon Beast Kings deep in the mountain range have commanded the ferocious beasts to leave this area?”

The lean elder ‘Qu Zhuang’ didn’t think much of it.

Even though the Black Mist Mountain Range was the territory of ferocious demonic beasts, under the invasion of the Foreign Evil God, humans and demonic beasts had long since come to a mutual understanding.

“Hopefully.”

Liao An thought for a moment and also felt he might be overthinking it.

This was a major rear area in the Tianqing World; it wasn’t absolutely safe but wasn’t far from it. It was clearly inappropriate to maintain the same level of alertness here as on the battlefield against the Evil Gods.

“Let’s go.”

“We should be close.”

The lean elder ‘Qu Zhuang’ quickened his flying speed.

Liao An followed closely behind, heading deeper into the Black Mist Mountain Range.

Boom, boom, boom.

Just then.

A gigantic creature nearly a hundred feet tall blocked their way.

This massive creature was none other than the Divine Ape King, acting on Lin Yuan’s orders to patrol the Black Mist Mountain Range.

“It is one of the eight kings of the Black Mist Mountain Range, known as the ‘Divine Ape King.’

The lean elder ‘Qu Zhuang’ upon seeing the Divine Ape King, was not startled but delighted, and turned to introduce it to Liao An.

“Divine Ape King?”

Liao An sized him up and down, nodding slightly.

Just from the aura alone, the Divine Ape King surpassed the average newly advanced Sixth Rank cultivators.

With his colossal physique coupled with the inherent talents of Demonic Beasts, even a Sixth Rank Peak cultivator would not dare to underestimate him.

“Divine Ape King, we are here by the mandate of the Alliance Hierarch to grant amnesty to you, the Demon Beast Kings, to go to the Evil God Battlefield…”

The gaunt elder Qu Zhuang finished introducing Liao An and didn’t beat around the bush, but directly transmitted his message to the Divine Ape King.

“To the Evil God Battlefield?”

The Divine Ape King naturally wouldn’t agree. Currently, he only followed Lin Yuan’s commands, and as for whatever Tianqing Alliance Leader, it naturally didn’t catch his attention.

“Not going.”

The Divine Ape King was resolute.

“Not going?”

The gaunt elder Qu Zhuang was startled, seemed to think of something, and then slapped his forehead.

“Almost forgot.”

“This is the mandate of the Alliance Hierarch; you should go now.”

The gaunt elder pulled out a token marked with the characters “Tianqing.”

The token, only the size of a palm, emitted strange fluctuations that couldn’t be duplicated or replaced.

“The mandate of the Alliance Hierarch?”

The Divine Ape King observed it closely for a few moments.

Although it was parasitized by the Demon Seed, it retained memories from before and knew what the mandate of the Alliance Hierarch truly implied.

It was the highest power within the Tianqing World, where every life form, be it human or Demonic Beast, must heed the command.

However, this did not include the Divine Ape King.

The Divine Ape King only recognized orders from Lin Yuan.

“Hold on, I will contact the other Kings.”

The Divine Ape King closed his eyes, secretly reaching out to Lin Yuan.

…..

In the deepest parts of the Black Mist Mountain Range.

Lin Yuan was still immersed in “Enlightenment.”

Since the Ancestral Demon Tree had lifted many restrictions on him, a variety of the Ancestral Demon Tree’s innate abilities awakened within Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan barely rested, constantly analyzing these with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, extracting their essence and discarding their dregs, integrating them into his Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“Didn’t expect that when the Ancestral Demon Tree lifted the restrictions, it even greatly enhanced the abilities of the Demon Tree Seeds…”

Lin Yuan slightly lamented.

The Demon Tree Seeds were abilities naturally mastered by a progeny Demon Tree.

They didn’t require the Ancestral Demon Tree’s explicit instruction to be unleashed and would naturally possess them upon reaching a certain stage.

Originally, Lin Yuan thought the Demon Tree Seeds were an unmodified method by the Ancestral Demon Tree.

But now, it was clear that he had underestimated the Ancestral Demon Tree’s precautions with its progeny.

The most obvious indication was after the Ancestral Demon Tree lifted the suppression on Lin Yuan, he not only awakened a vast number of former abilities.

But even the existing Demon Tree Seeds were significantly improved.

The improvement here was comprehensive; Lin Yuan, with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, perfected the Demon Tree Seeds, greatly enhancing their parasitic capabilities.

The parasitized, once infected, looked almost indistinguishable from before, seamlessly deceptive.

Similarly, after perfecting the Demon Tree Seeds, Lin Yuan could only condense a hundred of them at most.

Now, the number of perfected Demon Tree Seeds Lin Yuan could condense had increased from a hundred to three hundred.

“Three hundred perfected Demon Seeds, no need to be so selective now…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Up to now, only seven Demon Beast Kings had been parasitized by Lin Yuan.

As for the others? He had no interest in those Demonic Beasts below the Demon Beast Kings.

“Eh?”

“Someone’s entered the Black Mist Mountain Range?”

Lin Yuan seemed to sense something and looked toward a direction.

Currently, Lin Yuan’s roots had spread throughout the entire Black Mist Mountain Range.

Anything happening within this range couldn’t escape Lin Yuan’s perception.

The moment the two elders of the Tianqing Alliance stepped into the Black Mist Mountain Range, Lin Yuan detected them.

“Those two… possess Sixth Rank strength?”

Lin Yuan felt carefully for a moment.

A moment later.

The Divine Ape King, through the Demon Tree Seed, conveyed a message back to Lin Yuan saying that the visitors were two elders from the Tianqing Alliance…

“Two Sixth Rank elders from the Tianqing Alliance…”

A smile formed on Lin Yuan’s face.

How fortuitous! He had been considering finding new parasitic hosts, and these Tianqing Alliance elders just showed up?
